directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai keeps the printed wording for Concrete Pump Delivery Hose. The listed path is /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Concrete Pump Delivery Hose at /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it. Copy only the printed cells: Part type Concrete pump delivery / placing hose. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. The published cells are: Part type Concrete pump delivery / placing hose. It is the content image from the source article, not a Pinjin nameplate. The section “WHAT are EPDs” is only the heading taken from the source page.
